newsitem.title: LATVIA: RTF Q1 PROFIT WITH SUBSIDIARIES 1.17 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: RTF Q1 PROFIT WITH SUBSIDIARIES 1.17 MLN LATS.

text.p: Riga Transport Fleet said on Friday that its first quarter profit together with its daughter companies came to 1.17 million lats against 1.23 million lats in the same period last year.
"After-tax profit of RTF together with daughter companies in the first quarter is 1.172 million lats and that of RTF alone was 229,754 lats," Antonina Burgelis, RTF's chief accountant, told Reuters.
RTF, an official list stock on the Riga bourse, earlier reported a 1996 after-tax profit of 182,179 lats on net turnover of 11.44 million lats.
